reason: A DSH maintenance plugin and CLI that repackages fragmented zstd session logs into a compact two-frame format while preserving decompressed content.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH 会话日志中的多个 zstd 帧重打包为紧凑的两帧格式，并支持周期维护和命令行处理。
summaries.en: Repackages fragmented zstd frames in DSH session logs into a compact two-frame format with scheduled maintenance and command-line processing.

capabilities: Reads and decompresses session log data
Recompresses and atomically replaces eligible session files
Runs periodic maintenance when installed as a DSH plugin
Provides a command-line dry-run and targeted file processing mode
